steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0057_tonic_gaba_sweep_t0053 branch from main and write step_tracker.json.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0009, t0011, t0012, t0053 are completed.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the mandatory task folder structure including assets/library/ for the expected library asset.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: prior literature surveys (t0017, t0018) and the brainstorm-10 specification supply the literature context for tonic GABA / sustained IPSC mechanism.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: NEURON MOD file syntax for sustained conductance is well-established; task is implementation-focused with explicit specification.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0053 (parent task with same morphology, placement, E-mechanism, AIS, HH; only GABA mechanism changes), t0011 visualisation library, and t0012 scoring library to identify direct reuse and the swap surface for the new gaba_tonic.mod inhibition driver.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesize research-code into plan/plan.md with concrete code design for the gaba_tonic.mod point process, the per-synapse window-based weighting scheme, the 5-value GABA_BASE_NS sweep harness, and the regression / cross-conductance summary plotting pipeline.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Skipped: task runs on local CPU only ($0 budget).

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Build the minimal_dsgc_tonic_gaba_sweep library asset with new gaba_tonic.mod point process, run 12 directions x 10 trials x 3 modes x 5 GABA_BASE_NS values (1800 trials), produce per-direction plots and metrics for each conductance, plus cross-conductance summary plots.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Skipped: no remote machines were used.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: task design is fully specified by brainstorm 10; the sweep grid and reporting structure leave no room for exploratory analysis at this stage.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json (multi-variant, one variant per GABA_BASE_NS), costs.json, remote_machines_used.json; embed cross-conductance summary plots and selected per-direction representatives.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare per-conductance DSI, peak rate, HWHM, and tuning shape against t0053 (parent), t0052 (scalar gabaMOD sibling), Park 2014, and de Rosenroll 2026 published benchmarks.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up suggestions covering tonic-GABA propagation back to t0052 / t0054 architectures, biophysical refinements (e.g., variable t_on/t_off windows, hybrid tonic + transient), and any operating-point insights from the sweep.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, set status=completed, push branch, open PR, run pre-merge verificator, merge.
